summary.text: Kenneth J. Cianchette is the Republican candidate for the Maine State Senate, District 26, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 9, 2026 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as business owner, general manager, property manager and project manager.

paragraphs.text: Kenneth J. Cianchette was born in Portland, Maine, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maine in 2010.
Ballotpedia lists affiliations with the Chamber of Commerce and Hospitality Maine.
